title: Kiln Firing Service (Electric & Gas)
source_quote: LUX Center for the Arts Ceramics Center offers ceramic firing services in Lincoln, NE. Our electric kilns can be fired up to cone 6 and we fire our gas kiln up to cone 10. The firing cost is based on piece size and firing temperature. We charge $0.04 per cubic inch to bisque fire to cone 04, $0.06 per cubic inch to fire to cone 6, and $0.08 per cubic inch to fire to cone 10 in the gas kiln.
evidence_sentence: The center offers public kiln firing services by piece size at cone 04, cone 6, and cone 10.
evidence_quote: Our electric kilns can be fired up to cone 6 and we fire our gas kiln up to cone 10.
summary: Bring bisqued pots for firing at $0.04–$0.08 per cubic inch depending on temperature. Electric kilns fire cone 04–6; gas kiln fires cone 10. Firing dates estimated when dropping off pieces.
cost_text: $0.04 per cubic inch (cone 04), $0.06 per cubic inch (cone 6), $0.08 per cubic inch (cone 10 gas)
how_to_join: Contact Stacy Larson, Ceramics Center Manager, at stacy@luxcenter.org
